topics.description: The child care assistance program is trending due to the freezing of federal funds in Minnesota, which has affected many child care providers and families. The program is a critical support system for low-income families, and the freeze has raised concerns about the impact on these families.

The ICE shooting in Minneapolis is trending due to the controversy surrounding the incident and the investigation. The shooting has raised concerns about the use of force by law enforcement and the impact on the community.
